record.title: Kastanies–Pazarkule gate closure following February 2020 migration confrontation
record.scope: Specific road/pedestrian crossing, later subject to pandemic admission restrictions
record.direction: Gate service affected; initial stated concern was entry into Greece.
record.movement: Users of the named gate; no national Greece–Turkey total freight closure inferred.
record.exceptions: Other crossings and exceptional admission remained possible; July 2021 resumption retained eligibility/health limits.
record.imposing_authority: Greek authorities at Kastanies; bilateral gate operation affected
record.enforcement: Contemporary closure report; reopening includes traveller testimony.
record.consequences: Travellers describe diversion through Ipsala and lost convenient local passage.
record.relationship: Promotes gate episode from EU-L012. Does not duplicate Greece–Albania/North Macedonia R5-EU-004.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; not a present-day status assessment
record.official_rationale: Initial suspension to prevent uncontrolled entry as migrants gathered; subsequent operation was constrained by COVID-19 admission rules.
record.context: A July 2020 announced opening conflicts with later reports of a sixteen-month shutdown. Actual eligible passenger passage is documented on 3 July 2021.
record.uncertainty: Uninterrupted sixteen-month closure and the transition from migration to pandemic measures are not independently reconstructed; announced July 2020 reopening is not treated as actual.

historical.duration_note: No supported continuous operational interval for the stated scope. Mixed reasons, unresolved intervening announcement and category-limited resumption make a single duration unjustified.
